cloudbase.description: CloudBase MCP 2.34.3 for infrastructure work: inspection (postgres, vpc, tcbr) and the AI CloudRun deploy (scripts/deploy-ai-cloudrun.mjs), which needs this version to replace a service's settings outright and to attach a VPC when it creates a service. Use with: npx mcporter --config config/mcporter.infra.json call cloudbase.<tool> ... The CloudBase functions and site deploy must stay on config/mcporter.json, which pins the version its gateway calls were reviewed against.
